facts.statement: In the story behind the card, unruly Bixies have invaded the Bixie Hive and captured the Bixie Queen's workers; players defeat creatures such as the Invading Bixie Elite to save them.
facts.quote: Some unruly Bixies have invaded the Bixie Hive and captured her workers.

article_summaries.title: Bixies Gone Bad
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms site post by a game designer about the Trading Card Game (TCG) power-up card Invading Bixie Elite, tied to the Bixie Queen storyline. It explains that the card lets you play a free cost-1 creature from your flipped gems, which is destroyed at the end of your turn, and lists related cards with similar power-ups. The page gives no exact post date (only 'posted 1 week, 6 days ago').
